registration.reason: Original geometric checkerboard can separate inner test radii from outer training radii. This is a radial extrapolation confound.
registration.selection: Reuse all original guarded block interiors; choose block labels using geometry only, balancing radial bins and approaching/receding geometry. No spectra, amplitudes or velocities enter assignment.
registration.objective: Squared fractional count imbalance per radius/major-axis-sign cell, plus penalty for empty calibration or test radial bins; require both folds in an admitted radial bin.
registration.guard: Existing 120 arcsec block guard; every candidate block has the same guard regardless of its label.
registration.initialization: Recompute systemic and rotation seeds using the NEW training spectra only. No parameters fitted to an earlier partition are reused.
registration.fitting: Same constrained model and multistart rule as constrained-cube-real-001.
registration.scope: Previously exposed development data with a repaired validation design, not independent confirmation. No new gas term is fitted.
